shortDescription: Create, Delete or Modify NFS Client(s) for existing exports on Infinibox

options.name: access_mode
options.description: Read Write or Read Only Access.

options.name: client
options.description: Client IP or Range. Ranges can be defined as follows 192.168.0.1-192.168.0.254.

options.name: no_root_squash
options.description: Don't squash root user to anonymous. Will be set to "no" on creation if not specified explicitly.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates/Modifies client when present and removes when absent.

options.name: stay_logged_in
options.description: If True, persist API session to disk. Load the session on subsequent module calls. Persisted sessions are only usable for stay_logged_in_minutes.

options.name: stay_logged_in_minutes
options.description: Number of minutes for which a persisted session may be reused. After this time, the session data will be deleted. The time should be shorter than the IBOX session timeout time.

options.name: user
options.description: Infinibox User username with sufficient priveledges ( see notes ).
